meaning: The words you type or say to an AI tool to tell it what you want.
clues: It is words you type or say to start something.
You give it to an AI tool, like a chatbot or a picture maker.
The clearer and more detailed it is, the better the answer tends to be.
You might write "Explain this in simple words" or "Draw a cat in a hat."
It has six letters and starts with P. It also means to nudge someone to speak.
assumes: A search query is words typed into a search box
A caption is words printed with a picture
A keyboard shortcut is keys pressed together

decoys.meaning: The words you type into a search box to look something up.
Words printed with a picture to describe it.
A set of keys pressed together to do a task fast, like Ctrl and C.

exchange.text: Today you can use plain English. Tip: add details, like who it is for and how long it should be.

why: Clear words help an AI tool know what you want.
short: Words you give an AI tool
